• For power users there's support for ICU regular expressions (both for find & for replace) but there's also support to search for built in patterns (i.e. empty fields, email addresses, phone numbers or web addresses)
• Choose where to search: in the entire document or specific columns, rows or cells
• Search for specific patterns like: emails, phones and web address
